source: Names, electronegativity: PubChem periodic table (https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/periodictable/JSON), public domain. Half-lives, abundances, atomic masses: IAEA Nuclear Data Section LiveChart (https://nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data?fields=ground_states&nuclides=all). Ground-state electron configurations: NIST Atomic Spectra Database (https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/IonEnergy/tblNew.html). Atomic weights: IUPAC abridged standard atomic weights; elements without stable isotopes carry the mass number of their longest-lived isotope.
